title: Animal Bite Treatment
whoMayAvail: All residents of Tuguegarao City needing immediate post-exposure prophylaxis for animal bites.
whoCanApply: Bite victims, or their guardians/parents for minors.

requirements.name: Proof of Tuguegarao City residency (e.g. valid ID)

steps: Wash the bite wound thoroughly with soap and running water for 10-15 minutes.
Proceed to the Provincial Animal Bite Treatment Center immediately.
Present proof of residency to the registration desk.
Undergo assessment by the attending physician/nurse.
Receive the initial dose of the anti-rabies vaccine.
Follow the given schedule for subsequent vaccine doses.
